description: Itsuki protected local memory lifecycle for Codex

hooks.commandWindows: $itsukiPluginRoot = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('PLUGIN_ROOT', 'Process'); if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($itsukiPluginRoot) -or -not [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($itsukiPluginRoot)) { throw 'Codex did not provide an absolute PLUGIN_ROOT.' }; $itsukiPluginRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($itsukiPluginRoot); & ([IO.Path]::Combine([Environment]::SystemDirectory, 'WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe')) -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ([IO.Path]::Combine($itsukiPluginRoot, 'hooks\codex-launch.ps1')) -Hook SessionStart

$itsukiPluginRoot = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('PLUGIN_ROOT', 'Process'); if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($itsukiPluginRoot) -or -not [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($itsukiPluginRoot)) { throw 'Codex did not provide an absolute PLUGIN_ROOT.' }; $itsukiPluginRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($itsukiPluginRoot); & ([IO.Path]::Combine([Environment]::SystemDirectory, 'WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe')) -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ([IO.Path]::Combine($itsukiPluginRoot, 'hooks\codex-launch.ps1')) -Hook SessionEnd
